title: Ballerino
summary: A 2D pixel-art online multiplayer football game with strategic card mechanics. Inspired by Haxball: players build decks that change offense, defense and movement in real time, across 1v1, 2v2 and 3v3 matches.

title: Sultanahmet: Historical Layers
summary: An interactive WebGL experience exploring the historical layers of Sultanahmet: walk reconstructed streets, find hidden details and interact with historical objects.

title: Santa's House: Ice Breaking
summary: A three-day jam game built with my team during Game Jam 3.
